limitations: Linearised (eigenvalue) buckling: prebuckling resultants are not updated, so the anchor carries no post-buckling reserve and no ultimate strength.
Rotational geometric stiffness terms are omitted; the simply supported plate agreement with the closed form quantifies that omission.
The repository's panel path (stiffened_panel_unit_fe) is geometrically linear and cannot supply a limit point, so campaign criteria (b), (c) and (d) are WITHHELD.

The buckling operator uses the MITC4 flat shell rather than the layered Shell4 of the nonlinear path, because the layered element's one-point shear field carries hourglass modes that make the pure bending operator singular.
No experimental value is quoted anywhere in this anchor.

campaign_criteria.note: the campaign's six acceptance criteria, graded on this anchor's evidence only; a criterion the repository cannot support is recorded as FAIL or WITHHELD instead of being inferred

(b)_ultimate_vs_Paik2007_experiment.reason: primary experimental table unavailable; repository policy forbids quoting it from memory (see benchmarks/paik_thayamballi_2003_specimens.json)

(c)_postbuckling_path_vs_experiment.reason: the panel path in the repository is geometrically linear: no limit point, no descending branch, no energy absorption to compare (measured: applied stress 0.325 sigma_y with maximum plastic strain 0.0e+00 and a deflection-versus-load proportionality residual of 1.8e-14)

(d)_smith_Mkappa_vs_fem_full_model.reason: no geometrically nonlinear full-section FE exists in the repository, so there is no full-model M-kappa to compare the Smith curve against

(e)_csr_section_modulus.reason: the rule design bending moment of the applicable CSR edition is not available; only the actual section moduli are reported
